profile.headline: I am retired!
profile.summary: It was fun while it lasted!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Integrated Argo’s first TILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure (TRID) document generation software into the  Lending product.  Analyzed all TILA-RESPA data elements from Argo’s data base elements through all data transformations to the final destinations in Wolters Kluwer SQL tables.  Configured SQL tables, document generation software, and middle tier code, and C# user exits, and unit tests. Integrated usage of new paperless Document Viewer as well to handle generated PDF forms.
Created 4 Excel workbooks with 112 worksheets organized by data source/type to link Argo data to Wolters Kluwer data elements for mapping to their packaged forms.  
Completed in time for the October 2015 federal deadline and customer implementation.

Refactored C# user exits for Wolters Kluwer mapping project and created easily configured C# Unit Tests  using Visual Studio 2012.  Regression tested to confirm accuracy of refactored code. 
Greatly improved the adaptability of the testing process and maintainability of the C# code base.

Designed and implemented several new features for lending product using Argo Data’s proprietary middle-tier ADS language,   AJAX JSON web architecture, MVC design template, and SQL container objects. 

Helped improve design of MVC template pattern to allow for differences in the input and output data stream.

Uncovered hidden defects in Credit Bureau processing for single and multiple loan applicants. 
Analyzed, designed, and refactored JavaScript HTML front end and ADS middle tier to correct defects in bureau processing. 
Application now has fully functional fault free credit bureau processing.

Indirect Loan product was multiple releases behind on the current Argo Browser Core Framework. 
Upgraded through several major releases, removed beta test code and fixed many issues. 

Enhanced base product code by thorough investigation, creative solutions and careful testing with Visual Studio of scores of defect with less than 2 percent kickback from QA testing.

positions.title: Systems Analyst Developer
positions.description:
Software Engineer – (Six month contract)
Product Development for Banking application.

Discovered undetected serious data structure errors in back end to web transfer process.
Revised front end and back end to accommodate large expansion to data transfer. 
        Increased accuracy of history reporting by 40%.  Prevented future customer complaints.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Analyst Developer
positions.description:
Contracted to improve disasater recovery performance. 
Customer unable to overcome performance and cost issues with disaster recovery system.
•  Analyzed key factors. Designed and implemented new process resolving all issues. 
Increased profitability by $570,000.  Reduced storage usage 84% and back up runs by 50%.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Analyst Developer
positions.description:
Technology management support for client, 7-Eleven. Note: HP purchased EDS the original vendor.
Existing COBOL programs compiled in obsolete COBOL II. Project needed to upgrade to Enterprise COBOL.
•  Justified project with demonstration of CPU cost savings. Created new compile process for change control system to facilitate project. Identified programs to be recompiled.  
Reduced execution CPU time by up to 80 percent for 3800 affected programs.

Assembler CICS application programs were incompatible with operating system extended 32 bit addressing
•  Researched and converted all programs for 32 bit addressing, reentrancy, and other coding issues. 
Saved estimated $500,000 conversion while extending lifespan and reliability.

Access to archived reports in report management system (X/PTR) would be severed by accounting center reorganization. Needed to avoid high cost security and report database changes.
•  Designed and implemented scheme to cross index accounting centers with distribution table.
Avoided costly changes to security privileges and report databases. Kept all company departments connected to correct versions of vital reports.

Data center and application recovery strategies had incompatible restore points.
• Designed and tested new strategy for DASD and tape catalog synchronization using disaster recovery product, DRVFI. 
Moved from weekly restore points to daily ones. Reduced recovery time and required DASD space by 50%.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Analyst Developer
positions.description:
Technology Management. Supported retail, corporate, and human resource applications.

New enterprise report distribution system (X/PTR) needed security and routing scheme for 1200 reports.
•	Designed and implemented an automated report security and distribution model using employee roles indexed to corporate accounting hierarchies.
Revolutionized report usage and management. Saved over $3,000,000 annually.

Manual administration of mainframe security user base not compliant with Sarbanes Oxley requirements.
•	Integrated 15,000 RACF user accounts into Windows based Sun Identity Management system for SOX compliance. Designed new user request interfaces, tracking, and fulfillment processes.
Achieved SOX compliance. Improved processing of user requests and administration.

Maintaining and using the existing disaster recovery methodology was difficult and costly.
•	Customized and implemented new strategy using new disaster recovery product, DRVFI.
Reduced business loss exposure by 85% and recovery time by 50%.

CA-IDEAL and SDF2 application components resided outside of the change control system risking various change control related failures. Their complex proprietary repository and development environments complicated integration with change control product.   
•	Developed user friendly interfaces to integrate these products into the change control system while retaining the use of their native development environments. 
Eliminated all change control related failures for these unique components. 

Change control methods were ineffective or non-existent.
•	Researched customized source/object control product and usage policies. Implemented ChangeMan. Converted 25,000 components and trained IT department users. 
Resolved installation failures, component corruption/loss, and other change control issues. Saved lost time and business interruptions.
